name: descript
label: Descript
description: AI-powered video and podcast editor. Import media, run AI edits with Underlord, and publish.

token.label: API Token
token.description:
To create an API token:
1. Open **Settings** in Descript.
2. Select **API tokens** from the sidebar.
3. Click **Create token**, give it a name, select a Drive, and click **Create token**.
4. Copy the token and paste it here — you can only view it once.

import_media.label: Import Media
import_media.description: Imports a media file from a URL into a new or existing Descript project and optionally creates a composition.

mode.label: Project
mode.description: Create a new project or import into an existing one.

project_id.label: Existing Project
project_id.description: Select the project to import media into.

project_name.label: New Project Name
project_name.description: Name for the new project. Only used when creating a new project.

folder_name.label: Project Folder
folder_name.description: Folder path for the new project (e.g. "Clients/Acme"). Supports nested paths using "/". Missing folders are created automatically. Only applies when creating a new project.

team_access.label: Team Access
team_access.description: Access level for Drive members on the new project. Only applies when creating a new project.

media_name.label: Media File Name
media_name.description: Display name for the media file (e.g. "intro.mp4" or "Recordings/interview.mp4"). Use "/" to organize into sub-folders. Must not conflict with existing file names when importing into an existing project.

media_url.label: Media URL
media_url.description: Public URL of the media file. Must be accessible by Descript servers and support HTTP Range requests. Sign URLs for 12–48 hours if they expire.

language.label: Transcription Language
language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for transcription (e.g. "en", "es", "fr"). Leave blank to auto-detect from the audio.

composition_name.label: Composition Name
composition_name.description: Name for the composition (timeline) to create from the imported media. Leave blank to skip composition creation.

composition_width.label: Composition Width (px)
composition_width.description: Width of the composition in pixels. Defaults to 1920. Only used when a Composition Name is provided.

composition_height.label: Composition Height (px)
composition_height.description: Height of the composition in pixels. Defaults to 1080. Only used when a Composition Name is provided.

callback_url.label: Callback URL
callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When the import finishes or fails, Descript will POST the job status to this URL (same payload as Get Job Status).

agent_edit.label: Agent Edit (Underlord)
agent_edit.description: Use Descript's AI agent "Underlord" to edit an existing project or create a new one with a natural language prompt.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to edit an existing project or create a brand new one.

project_id.label: Project
project_id.description: Select the project for the agent to edit.

project_name.label: New Project Name
project_name.description: Name for the new project (only used when creating a new project).

team_access.label: Team Access
team_access.description: Access level for team members on the new project. Only applies when creating a new project.

composition_id.label: Composition
composition_id.description: Select the composition (timeline) within the project. If omitted, the agent chooses automatically.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural language instruction for Underlord. Examples: "Add studio sound to every clip", "Remove all filler words", "Create a 30-second highlight reel with the best moments". Be specific — frame edits as a single one-shot instruction.

model.label: AI Model
model.description: AI model to use for editing. Leave blank to use the Descript default.

callback_url.label: Callback URL
callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When the job finishes or fails, Descript will POST the job status to this URL (same payload as Get Job Status).

publish_project.label: Publish Project
publish_project.description: Publishes a composition from a project to create a shareable link and a downloadable export file.

project_id.label: Project
project_id.description: Select the Descript project to use.

composition_id.label: Composition
composition_id.description: Select the composition (timeline) within the project. If omitted, the agent chooses automatically.

media_type.label: Output Type
media_type.description: Choose whether to export the project as a video or audio file.

resolution.label: Video Resolution
resolution.description: Resolution for the exported video. Only applies when Output Type is Video.

access_level.label: Share Access Level
access_level.description: Who can view the published share page. Leave blank to use your Drive's default. Note: requesting a level your Drive disallows (e.g. Public when search-engine indexing is off) will return an error.

callback_url.label: Callback URL
callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL. When the publish job finishes or fails, Descript will POST the job status to this URL (same payload as Get Job Status). The result includes share_url and download_url once complete.

get_job_status.label: Get Job Status
get_job_status.description: Retrieves the current status of a Descript background job (import, agent edit, or publish). Use the job_id returned by any job-creation action.

job_id.label: Job ID
job_id.description: The job ID returned when you created the job (e.g. from "Import Media", "Agent Edit", or "Publish Project" actions).

list_projects.label: List Projects
list_projects.description: Returns projects in your Descript Drive. Supports filtering by name, date, and creator.

name.label: Name Filter
name.description: Return only projects whose name contains this string (case-insensitive).

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Return only projects created after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z).

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Return only projects created before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z).

updated_after.label: Updated After
updated_after.description: Return only projects updated after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z).

updated_before.label: Updated Before
updated_before.description: Return only projects updated before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z).

get_project.label: Get Project
get_project.description: Retrieves details for a Descript project including its compositions and media files.

project_id.label: Project
project_id.description: Select the Descript project to use.
